Hi Natalie — thanks for the note and the clear asks. Below is a concise, customer-friendly summary and a short technical appendix; we'll attach detailed evidence.

Customer-facing summary (one paragraph):
Redwood identified a temporary lapse in documented access-review evidence for a non-customer-facing backend service during the Type II audit period. The lapse was administrative (missing timestamped sign-off) and did not result in unauthorized access or data exposure. We have implemented a controlled remediation plan (automated monthly attestations, an owner-assigned ticketing workflow, and a retroactive evidence upload) and expect closure within 45 days. We will provide an interim management statement and, if requested, a bridge letter covering the audit window.

Root cause (short):
- Owner-change during re-org + manual process steps created a gap in the attestations pipeline (no change to access rights).

Remediation plan & timeline (owner: Laura Bennett, Director, Security Ops):
- Day 0–7: owner confirmed scope and retroactively collected logs and sign-offs (complete).
- Day 8–21: deploy automated monthly attestation flows and ticketing (in progress).
- Day 22–45: full evidence reconciliation and final closure notice; auditors to validate.

Attachments we will share: ctl-closure-roadmap-v1.pdf (remediation roadmap), finding-1207-annotated.xlsx (annotated evidence matrix), and a short management statement draft.

Next steps:
1) Laura will send a technical evidence bundle to Priya for auditor validation by Thu 12/2.
2) I will send the customer-facing one-paragraph note you can use; feel free to edit.
3) If Finmerce would like a bridge letter, we can prepare a draft for you by 12/8.

Marissa
Head of Customer Security — Redwood Inference

Thanks, Laura — received the bundle and reviewed the annotated index. A couple of clarifying questions before we can mark this as closed for audit purposes: 

1) The tagged attestations — can you confirm whether the automated monthly attestation creates a tamper-evident record (e.g., stored in immutable storage or with a checksum)? If not, auditor team would prefer a stronger chain-of-custody for attestations.
2) For the retroactive evidence: were there any gaps (dates without a signature) that remain unresolved? If so, please enumerate which dates and the mitigating evidence.

If you can respond with the two points above and a short confirmation that there was no production data exposure, we'll proceed to update our audit working papers and provide Finmerce with a closure note.

Best,
Priya
Senior Auditor — Assurance Partners

Subject: Final customer note: control closure roadmap and short Q&A (for Finmerce)

Hi Natalie — thanks for your patience. Below is a short customer-facing note you can share with your security and procurement teams, plus a short Q&A based on Priya's clarifications.

Customer-facing note (single paragraph):
Redwood Inference identified an administrative gap related to access-review attestations for a non-customer-facing backend service during the SOC 2 Type II audit period. There was no evidence of unauthorized access or production data exposure. We remediated the issue through retroactive evidence reconciliation, automated monthly attestations with a ticketing-based owner workflow, and policy updates. Expected closure is within 45 days from 2027-12-01; auditors have been provided the evidence bundle and will validate closure for the reporting period. On request, Redwood will provide a short bridge letter describing the remediation timeline and auditor validation status.

Short Q&A (for procurement/security):
Q: Was customer data exposed?
A: No — the affected service does not process customer PII or customer plaintext content; artifacts provided are system-level logs and attestations.

Q: How is Redwood preventing recurrence?
A: We've automated attestations, added tagging and alerts for missing sign-offs, and assigned an explicit owner (Laura Bennett) responsible for evidence collection and reporting.

Q: Can we get a bridge letter?
A: Yes — we can draft a bridge letter and provide it by 2027-12-08 if requested.

If you'd like, I can convert the paragraph and Q&A into a short PDF you can attach to your vendor file. Please let me know if any edits are needed.

Thanks again,
Marissa
